about: Per-poet verdicts from the Phase 8 reading of the textbooks (tool/literature/poet_coverage.py). a: verse exists and can be published; b: verse exists but is not the poet's; c: the chapter prints no publishable verse (prose, or only a lone bayt, which is never published as a work); d: no chapter in these books. «chapters» corrects the pages a biography cites.
